productConcept.name: Maison Cendre
productConcept.description: A Parisian house of preserved delicacies, small-batch caviar, and foraged botanicals.
productConcept.rationale: Dark near-black palette (#19191c) + Casper's Caviar editorial origin + Montserrat tracked at 0.08em + springy physical motion system all point to premium artisan food with luxe editorial presentation. Caviar, conservas, and botanical tinctures fit the material/deliberate aesthetic perfectly.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — concept_by_video.md explicitly describes springy cubic-bezier(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55) easing, parallax, scroll-triggered staggered reveals, and 400-700ms durations. Motion system has clear substance.
